title: Alexander says MJ-12 was continuity of government

as_told.title: John Alexander: MJ12 was real but about continuity of government

plain: This story is about Majestic 12, or MJ-12, a secret group long rumoured to have handled UFO matters for the US government. An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that a retired colonel, John B. Alexander, called MJ-12 a continuity of government programme, meaning a plan to keep the government running after a disaster. Another UFO researcher, Grant Cameron, says Alexander told an interviewer that MJ-12 did exist, but had nothing to do with UFOs. People tell it because, if true, it would change what a famous name in UFO lore actually stood for.
